findings.issue_text: The assertion at GroupTest.java:159 runs before the reader thread terminates, allowing an in-flight request to append an exception after the assertion passes and hide a concurrent-access failure.
If a deletion throws at GroupTest.java:154–157, deletedAll is never set, leaving the reader thread issuing requests indefinitely.

goldens.comment: Returning null from getSubGroupsCount() violates the GroupModel contract (Javadoc says it never returns null) and may lead to NPEs in callers that expect a non-null count.
The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.

adjudication_records.issue_text: If a deletion throws at GroupTest.java:154–157, deletedAll is never set, leaving the reader thread issuing requests indefinitely.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the test code, the deletion loop at lines 154-157 uses forEach to delete groups. If an exception is thrown during deletion, the forEach would terminate early and deletedAll.set(true) at line 158 would never be called. This would leave the reader thread in an infinite loop at lines 141-151, continuously making requests. This is a real bug in the test code - the deletedAll.set(true) should be in a finally block or the deletion should be wrapped in try-finally to ensure the flag is always set regardless of exceptions.
